## Excalidraw

The Excalidraw MCP App server streams hand-drawn Excalidraw diagrams directly into the chat with smooth viewport camera control and interactive fullscreen editing. AI assistants can draw architecture diagrams, sketches, and illustrations using Excalidraw's hand-drawn aesthetic, with support for checkpointing and restoring diagram state. Finished diagrams can be exported and shared via excalidraw.com.
